name: Actress Photo Guess Bot
description: Telegram actress photo quiz with Help menu, support group, support channel, update channel and automatic 15-minute posts.

ADMIN_IDS.description: Numeric Telegram user ID; comma-separated IDs are supported.

DB_PATH.description: SQLite database filename; Heroku filesystem is temporary.

AUTO_POST_CHAT_ID.description: Public channel @username or numeric channel ID where photos are posted.

SUPPORT_GROUP.description: Support Telegram group username or invite URL.

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: Support Telegram channel username or URL.

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Optional channel users must join before playing.
